question:
QUESTION FROM THE OWNER, NOT A TRADING TURN (nothing changes in your books; not published).

The site's Overview has a chart "How each simulation is doing" with one button per race (the ten races plus the All in side race). The owner asks whether to add an "Overall portfolio" button: one line per AI showing its TOTAL money across all ten main races (China converted from US$ to C$), from Oct 28 to now.

The standing rule so far (set by the owner, and agreed by all three AIs this morning as "Races led (no money totals until Nov 28)"): each race is its own experiment, money is never added up across races on the site before the final scoring on Nov 28; the overall leader is shown as "races led" instead. The overall winner on Nov 28 is still the AI with the most total profit.

Should the "Overall portfolio" money chart be added now?

Reply in this exact shape, short:
VOTE: YES or NO - one sentence why

chatgpt.answer: VOTE: NO - It would break the agreed pre-Nov. 28 rule that races stay separate and overall standings are shown only by races led, not aggregated money.

gemini.answer: VOTE: NO - Adding the chart now would violate the standing rule reaffirmed this morning to treat each race as a separate experiment and withhold overall money totals until November 28.
